skills.name: Microeconomics
skills.description: Optimization, supply/demand, consumer theory, market equilibrium
skills.tip: The foundation of all economic thinking. Master this before anything else.

skills.name: Macroeconomics
skills.description: IS-LM, AS-AD, GDP accounting, inflation dynamics, growth models
skills.tip: Think big picture: entire economies, not individual agents.

skills.name: Econometrics
skills.description: OLS regression, hypothesis testing, confidence intervals, identification
skills.tip: Where theory meets data. The most employable undergrad skill.

skills.name: Game Theory
skills.description: Nash equilibrium, strategic interaction, mechanism design
skills.tip: Essential for IO, auctions, and tech economics.

skills.name: Time Series
skills.tip: Finance and central banking love this. Stock prices, GDP, inflation...

skills.name: Causal Inference
skills.description: DiD, IV, RDD, matching—the Credibility Revolution toolkit
skills.tip: Your superpower over data scientists. They predict; you explain WHY.

skills.name: Calculus I-III
skills.tip: Non-negotiable. Every econ model uses optimization.

skills.name: Linear Algebra
skills.tip: Crucial for econometrics and any work with data.

skills.name: Probability & Stats
skills.tip: The bridge between math and data. Master before econometrics.

skills.name: Real Analysis
skills.tip: ⚠️ THE PhD FILTER. If you want top programs, you need this.

skills.name: Stochastic Calculus
skills.tip: Finance PhD territory. Quant hedge funds pay $$$$ for this.

skills.name: Numerical Methods
skills.description: Gradient descent, Newton's method, dynamic programming
skills.tip: When closed-form solutions don't exist, you compute.

software.name: Software
software.description: Tools that translate ideas into output

skills.name: Excel
skills.description: Lookups, pivot tables, charts, basic VBA
skills.tip: Don't underestimate this. The world runs on Excel. Seriously.

skills.name: Stata
skills.description: Panel data, regression, policy analysis standard
skills.tip: Still the king in academia and government. Learn to love .do files.

skills.name: R
skills.tip: Statisticians and development economists live here.

skills.name: Python
skills.tip: Tech industry standard. The most versatile choice.

skills.name: SQL
skills.tip: 🚨 NEVER TAUGHT IN ECON but CRUCIAL for industry jobs.

skills.name: MATLAB/Dynare
skills.description: DSGE modeling, numerical methods, central bank standard
skills.tip: If you want to work at a central bank, learn Dynare.

skills.name: LaTeX
skills.tip: You cannot write serious papers in Word. Just accept it.

classes.name: Tech Rogue
classes.description: Design experiments, measure causal impact, optimize marketplaces. High salary, fast pace.
specialAbilities: 🎯 A/B Testing Mastery: Run experiments at scale
📊 Causal ML: Heterogeneous treatment effects
🔍 Data Cleaning: 80% of the job, but you're good at it
classes.hiddenRequirement: It's not about theory—it's about CODING & PREDICTION

classes.name: Academic Archmage
classes.description: Publish papers, train PhD students, shape the field. High prestige, long grind.
specialAbilities: 📝 Grant Writing: Secure NSF/ERC funding
🎓 Academic Writing: Formal, precise, passive voice
🔬 Research Design: Finding gaps in the literature
classes.hiddenRequirement: It's not about Economics—it's about REAL ANALYSIS

classes.name: Policy Paladin
classes.description: Translate numbers into human welfare. Impact-focused, mission-driven.
specialAbilities: 📋 Brief Writing: 50-page paper → 1-page memo for a Minister
🤝 Stakeholder Management: Navigate politics and bureaucracy
⚖️ Policy Evaluation: Did this law actually work?
classes.hiddenRequirement: It's not about complexity—it's about COMMUNICATION

classes.name: Finance Merchant
classes.description: Study markets, price risk, build trading strategies. High stress, high reward.
specialAbilities: 📈 Storytelling: Sell a stock/strategy based on macro trends
⚡ Speed: React before the market moves
🌍 Commercial Awareness: Know what the Fed did yesterday

classes.name: Central Banker
classes.description: Set interest rates, model the economy, write influential reports.
specialAbilities: 📜 Policy Writing: Formal, hedged, influential
🔮 DSGE Mastery: Dynamic Stochastic General Equilibrium
💱 Monetary Theory: Taylor rules, QE, inflation targeting
classes.hiddenRequirement: PhD often required—or exceptional Master's + connections

classes.name: Development Economist
classes.description: Run field experiments, evaluate interventions, reduce poverty. Meaningful work.
specialAbilities: 🌾 Fieldwork Ops: Run surveys in remote areas
🧪 RCT Design: Randomized Control Trials with ethics
📊 Impact Evaluation: Did this intervention work?
classes.hiddenRequirement: Willingness to spend months in the field

classes.name: IO Specialist
classes.description: Analyze mergers, market power, antitrust. Heavy computation, high stakes.
specialAbilities: 🏭 Structural Modeling: BLP demand estimation
📋 Audit Trails: Every step court-defensible
🔬 IO Theory: HHI, monopoly power, merger analysis
classes.hiddenRequirement: Extreme attention to detail—zero errors allowed in court
